check.why: Deterministic checks first: quote verification, digest validation, conformance. They are the external feedback models lack.

scan.why: Reading many things to keep what matters.

extract.why: Pulling fields or passages out of text already found.

verify.why: A different model than the producer: evaluators favour their own outputs.

plan.why: Deciding what to do and what it is worth.

write.why: Synthesis that enters memory or reaches a person.

code.why: Changing code that others will run.
